Container.Name: timetap
Container.Overview: Timetap: working hours and projects, clocked with NFC readers, the web page or the iPhone app. The first login (Admin and a password) is printed once in the container's log: click the icon, then Logs.

Config.Name: Web page (http)
Config.Description: The port for the web page, the readers and the app. Unraid's own page has 80, so Timetap uses another.

Config.Name: Secure web page (https)
Config.Description: Used once IT > Secure address is set up.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, backups and settings. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: The time zone hours are counted in.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: The user Timetap's files belong to (Unraid's appdata: 99, nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: The group Timetap's files belong to (Unraid's appdata: 100, users).

Config.Name: This server's address
Config.Description: This Unraid server's IP address on your network, e.g. 192.168.1.20. Only needed for https (IT > Secure address).
